fieldValues.title: B9. Across the stages
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Concerns that sit in no single stage.
fieldValues.tensions:
- The owner's attention is the single sink: stages 2, 3, 6 and 7 each end in an owner act (affirm, rule, merge, receive), and fixes keep moving the act rather than removing it.
- One fact in many places: labels and records as two state systems, handbook text drifting from records (SP-67), copies of wt and session drifting, stale CLAUDE.md files (SP-65).
- In-flight work is not visible between stages (SP-59, SP-61).
- The process is repeatedly re-founded: the epic-worker skills (retired in August, srs#451), the unit walk (September), the reboot from Project #5 to #6 (10-08), units frozen then revived as holons (10-21).
- The pattern is older than SRS: the 2025 products vault ran domain, problem, persona, product, stories with human guidance fed to AI; semops2's TODO says planning complete, no implementation.
- A rule holds at the boundary that made it (boundaries ruling, 10-09); rules lifted out of their boundary cause most recorded contradictions.
